name: Black Lily
source:
"This flower field is a little secret between Onii-chan and us. So please feel free to drop by anytime the fancy takes you."

Lily is the black-haired maid at the manor who runs the kitchen. She's the go-to person for all meals and can whip up just about any dish, whether Japanese or Western. But her talents don't stop there—she has a green thumb, overseeing [url=/c136405]Lavender[/url]’s garden. 

While she might seem like the youngest and most innocent one, Lily holds a surprise in the age department, and she's not hiding it. She is a real people person, always full of energy. Without batting an eye, she hits it off with [url=/c136409]Akira[/url], an outsider.

Though clueless about TV and modern books, she knows her way around classic literature. And now, she's set her sights on the "story" Akira is cooking up.

[u][b]Akira's Memo[/b][/u]
This little maid is always so lively. Rumor has it she's got a few more candles on her birthday cake than you'd expect, but you'd never guess her actual age based on how she acts. Still, her wealth of knowledge doesn't align with her youthful looks. When chatting with her, I sometimes get this vibe that there's more beneath the surface. Out of all the maids, she's probably the biggest mystery.

[Translated and edited from the [url=https://escude.co.jp/product/femme_fatale/chara04.html]official website[/url]]
